name: Testfully
summary: Testfully combines an API client with test runs and monitoring for REST and GraphQL APIs. The Developer plan is free with no runner limit. Team costs $14 and Enterprise $29 per user a month, billed annually.

facts.text: The folder runner offers serial, parallel and random execution, concurrency limits, delays, CSV or JSON datasets and repeated iterations.
The runner is available on all plans with no monthly request limit.
Requests can carry checks on the response code, time, headers and body, and can be chained into a serial scenario.
The Developer plan includes one offline and one cloud workspace and up to 5 users per workspace.

plans.name: Developer Edition
plans.notes: 1 offline and 1 cloud workspace, up to 5 users per workspace, collection runner with no limits

plans.name: Team Edition
plans.notes: Billed annually; the page shows no monthly-billing price. Adds unlimited workspaces, Git integration for offline workspaces, role-based access and secret management. The page does not name a currency

plans.name: Enterprise Edition
plans.notes: Billed annually; the page shows no monthly-billing price. Adds single sign-on, SCIM, domain capture and audit logs. The page also points to Contact Sales

hiddenCosts: API Monitoring credits are a separate add-on: 10K for $10 a month, 30K for $27, 50K for $40 and 100K for $70.
